newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Eagle Financial Q3 oper shr profit.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Eagle Financial Q3 oper shr profit.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers. Return on equity is in percent.)
NOTE: Earnings on a core basis, which factors out the impact of non-recurring items, were $0.51 per share compared with $0.48 per share.

The company said the current quarter's results were reduced due to $10.9 million of net non-recurring items before income tax, including $6.5 million directly related to the MidConn acquisition, $3.4 million from a bulk sale of $17.7 million of problem loans, and $1.0 million of non-recurring expenses.
The company said the increase in core operating earnings was driven by a $1.6 million increase in net interest income, the primary component of its revenue.
The company had total assets at June 30, 1997 of $2.01 billion compared to $1.77 billion at June 30, 1996.
It had total deposits of $1.39 billion compared with $1.39 billion.
